capabilities.justification: Opens supervisor-chosen broker roots, canonicalizes them and the never-grantable paths to prove they are disjoint, and opens agent-named files strictly beneath a root.
Opens an agent-named file beneath a broker root for writing, when the brokered capability is a write.

capabilities.target: libc open(O_DIRECTORY), syscall(SYS_openat2) on Linux, openat with O_NOFOLLOW_ANY on macOS, and fcntl(F_GETFL, F_SETFL)
capabilities.justification: Beneath-resolution must use the platform's own primitive (D18S S-K5); std has no openat2 or O_NOFOLLOW_ANY.

justification: Path handling for the D18 broker's brokered filesystem capabilities.
